narrative: I lead backend and data engineering initiatives that keep customer-facing systems reliable, low-latency, and insight driven. My experience spans fintech platforms, AI-powered search, and academic portals serving thousands of users.

Across American Express and Guidepoint, I have implemented streaming data pipelines, microservices, and search infrastructure that cut latency, improved data fidelity, and accelerated releases through disciplined testing and automation.

I enjoy pairing with cross-functional partners to translate requirements into measurable outcomes, mentoring teams on engineering rigor, and refining operational excellence through observability, CI/CD, and cloud-native deployments.
